تتبادلي (form VI)
# تَتَبَادَلِي (tatabādalī) /ta.ta.baː.da.liː/: second-person feminine singular non-past active subjunctive/jussive of تَبَادَلَ (tabādala)
# تُتَبَادَلِي (tutabādalī) /tu.ta.baː.da.liː/: second-person feminine singular non-past passive subjunctive/jussive of تَبَادَلَ (tabādala)
maddeler.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
